$comment: Canonical elfyou brand values. Kept in sync with the 'e.l.f. Design System'
Claude Design project (see preview/brand-drift.html there for provenance).
`pnpm lint:tokens` fails when src/styles/tailwind.css disagrees with this
file. That check exists because #ff007a shipped as a brand colour for
months without anyone noticing it was invented.
When the design team changes a value, update this file and the stylesheet
together. When a value is knowingly left divergent, add it to
acceptedDeviations with a reason rather than deleting it from brand.

unconfirmed.$comment: No asset evidence. Carried from the port. Confirm or drop; do not build on these.

acceptedDeviations.$comment: Known, deliberate divergence from brand. Each entry must match the stylesheet exactly, so silently changing one still fails the check.

elfyou-indigo.reason: One step off the measured #454bc6 — visually identical, not worth a change.

elfyou-purple.reason: Measured brand purple is #a116f1. Left pending a decision alongside cream and mint-light.

elfyou-cream.reason: Brand assets use white for this role. Cream is a port-era choice; pending the same decision.

roles.$comment: Semantic role -> palette token. Components reference only roles.
roles.heading: elfyou-mint-light

campaignOnly.$comment: One-off event artwork. Never promote to a role or reuse on evergreen work.
